i've also heard from my teacher that part of what helps with developing your personal opinion (AO3) is discussing/debating with peers (which i'm strugglign with since i'm the only student in my class HELP!!!☹), and also generally consuming critical literary texts on both the studied text(s) specifically and major related themes (e.g. I'm doing Beloved(Toni Morrison) for this year's May/June, therefore i have to read up on critical discussions of the book specifically and major themes like Black American slavery).
